# shumoku_data_source (Resource)

A Shumoku data source: a configured plugin instance (Zabbix, NetBox, Prometheus, Grafana, ...) that topologies can attach. Requires an `admin` API token.

The plugin configuration is plugin-defined JSON; the `shumoku_data_source_types` data source lists each plugin's `configSchema`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "zabbix_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# config_json follows the plugin's configSchema
# (see the shumoku_data_source_types data source).
resource "shumoku_data_source" "zabbix" {
  name = "Zabbix"
  type = "zabbix"
  config_json = jsonencode({
    url   = "https://zabbix.example.com"
    token = var.zabbix_token
  })

  # Optional per-source polling overrides, in milliseconds.
  polling_alerts_ms = 30000
}

# Grafana with webhook alerts: the server generates the webhook secret.
resource "shumoku_data_source" "grafana" {
  name = "Grafana"
  type = "grafana"
  config_json = jsonencode({
    url        = "https://grafana.example.com"
    useWebhook = true
  })
}

output "grafana_webhook_secret" {
  value     = jsondecode(shumoku_data_source.grafana.effective_config_json).webhookSecret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config_json` (String, Sensitive) Plugin configuration as a JSON object string (use `jsonencode`), validated by the server against the plugin's `configSchema`. Sensitive, since it usually holds API tokens or passwords. An update replaces the whole configuration, except that a secret field (per the plugin's `configSchema`) omitted here keeps its stored value, so server-generated secrets such as a Grafana `webhookSecret` survive updates; set a secret to `""` to clear it.

Drift is judged only on the keys set here: keys the server adds itself (such as a generated Grafana `webhookSecret`) are ignored, and secret fields the server returns empty or masked are treated as unchanged. Compared semantically, so key order and whitespace do not cause diffs.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `type` (String) Plugin type, e.g. `zabbix`, `netbox`, `prometheus`, `grafana`. See `shumoku_data_source_types`. Changing it updates the data source in place (its topology attachments are kept), so change `config_json` together with it.

### Optional

- `polling_alerts_ms` (Number) Per-source alert polling interval override, in milliseconds. Unset uses the server-wide interval.
- `polling_metrics_ms` (Number) Per-source metrics polling interval override, in milliseconds. Unset uses the server-wide interval.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Creation time, Unix milliseconds.
- `effective_config_json` (String, Sensitive) The configuration as the server stores it, including keys it generated (for example a Grafana `webhookSecret`). Use `jsondecode` to read a value.
- `id` (String) Server-generated data source id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A data source is imported by its id. config_json is then read from the server.
terraform import shumoku_data_source.zabbix <data_source_id>
```
